[b] • ] Such kindness [   [/b]

Every one of our written encounters is an unattainable impracticality.
It’s captivating to be near, in how I sneak up to Our kumgan in this project.
Fulfilled on one hand, yet I realize how listing the entire clumsy procedure feels quite childish.
It would be more “author-like” to repeat what only a few seem to mention, but... it’s a thankless task, and the complexity varies.
Now, when the concept of an indie developer has become bushy and sprawling, it’s hard to distinguish, from the outside, which self-publishing kiosk truly deserves the perception of samizdat, and when it’s just a way to deliver primitive information into the unshakable baryonic essence of the crowd.
It’s easy to make mistakes here, where you’re supposed to rely on... yourself.
Can you imagine?
Can you imagine what a preciousness of a choice this is? How valuable the time you entrusted to this text is?
It’s insane to think about That which I never dreamed of wasting... Green, oh so green!        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/8f473a52eaf381d6573b94510433d92c83c172cf.png[/img]   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/494adf77571218833cde641819e9e0f83c534db8.png[/img]          

[b] • ] About colors. [[/b]   

So, let’s assume, but why the rare meeting?
Overflow.
The [b][url=https://potofu.me/zolynh   ]Zolynh[/url][/b] section, filled with its own avatars and links, is fuller than ever this year. There... the titles are conditional, indeed.
But let’s imagine for a moment that the world is neat.
Somewhere I just use the [url=https://bsky.app/hashtag/zolynh   ]#hashtag[/url], but I do use it. And so, Zolynh has been overcome by an inflammation of information, where this project has become the main publication. Far too much.
At first, it seemed to me that we’d meet again in three months, maybe eight...
And thus, a year passed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/ab47c7db7797311e84b670209f8bea0efb1e54f7.png[/img]

You see, copying content everywhere, being distracting with it, is effective but insignificant in... my volume.
It’s not devoid of meaning, although I can be careless, or rather disheveled and messy.
Human, but also untidy, offering up a heap of mistakes.
But to turn the presentation Here, to bring it closer to desk-drawer drafts... Ugh.
So, though I’m not speaking of exclusivity (I fear it’s beyond my reach), every three months, occupying the news with a list of what’s been uploaded, done, or conceived — by default, it would feel like a portfolio platform. Excessive self-admiration.
Not the kind of spot I’d want to reserve in Steam, especially given the various events. I hadn’t seriously forecasted posting something by this date. That’s already a celebration.    

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/d887d22a73d847667a978882f0cb6379be86b360.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/18f443d04f3bc7e0f5afe4b7f073c4eeac8e2bca.png[/img]

It’s remarkable that, months ago, it could have been possible to release the indirect consequences of certain ideas, related or not (directly) to “The 22nd is Serda. f0a178,” and make them part of the discussion. HOWEVER...
There’s maturation; a reason builds up. Impatience on my part builds up just as effectively.
But then, is there a reason? An unkind or a solid one, but something unbearably bothers me, something weighs on me, as the build is still not in early access.
Haste has no place here.
Is it misplaced in the grandeur of the world?
Did I put it on the shelf myself, or was it there for ages, only now deciding to appear?
Questions that are not for the gaming section.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/0d7d47d0ebbd8340c34f399d14552e0757095e18.png[/img]   

[b] • ] 20 years ago, urban pastures would have unfolded here. [[/b]   

Here is where it could end. Because after this, a technical enumeration of words would be cast ashore. But honestly, there doesn’t feel like a reason.
A reason to send this statement to the news archive.
Of course, there are times when the belly doesn’t... end.
And such drainage means lots of experiments. Lots of aberrations.
Which is why it matters to start differently, to reconcile with the obsessive imagery.            

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/16d536f8ed7a2f9c2e663e9994f2afee0d4a74d4.png[/img]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/fd820dddb7e0af228ce60b7f404b5d1d36249131.png[/img]    

The next message will be a camouflet for me as well — while this text is still in the process of being written, I have no idea what will later be embedded.
But it’s required.
After all, you already know — the progress of development hasn’t stopped. Moreover, the stream spreads to the corners of the box.
So, it requires meaning. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/fc7e720bf8b7b00387d075bee71e2ee0a600f0ec.png[/img]   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/282a191449bce88318796ce7913b6e8577a7fc94.png[/img]   

[b] • ] Why not... [choose carefree options for answers]? [   [/b]

Where is the praise? Where is the passion when I secretly recommend you, secretly adore you, or at least hint at that echo so needed by many?
It’s not about fearing to let someone down, but there’s a reason why I don’t specifically mention You or Matt’s enviable pepper seedlings.
Names, pseudonyms, activities. And, of course, I’ll inevitably miss something.
Not a studio of children’s and youth films, and yet I’m responsible for the plasticine crafted within the achievements of only this century.
To tinker here, to scurry about, to hang up whatever it may be — this is where Mr. Bear gazes widely at these agonizing letters. 
But I am a human spillover… Unpredictable, controllable.   
~
This year, no matter how I tried to preserve the shimmer of a flare... No.
Don’t take my word for it; in these times, our preferences are nothing but our delusions.
Without excess words, I’m not part of it, and judge me for breaking the rules.
It would have been an exciting mischief to invite you to sneak a peek at this one day[b]:  [/b]  
  
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212530/Anthology_Of_The_Killer/   
 I console myself that the emulsion is intact.

BUT for now, I haven’t denied myself a utopian mischief.
You.
You are still the greatest celebration, approaching or already fulfilled.

Occasionally it happens that the desire does not want to stop. Not at all willing to pretend to be a desperate, trusting correspondent. 
The canine in this stack of newspapers stands out for how well it holds on the finish of the sharpest blade, speeding for a couple of months without slowing down. Because it broke out of its booth, despite the frost. It appeared randomly, a matured sandy blister after a dispute in the October competition between invisible gladiators, where the ultimate privilege is to abstain. It spread its paws and surrendered to the rhythm.

There are processes that raise questions. 
And there are questions that give rise to processes... 
Doesn't sound as robust, but it's a special case - you have discovered a word from this text! Maybe even more than one. 
Are these letter enclosures so important? Impermissible to know. 
But it happened, and therein lies a kind of mystery. Holidays are somewhat like clocks. They also change, they also accompany events, and most importantly, each date has its own script. 
Or not? 
I fear it often seems like they do not. 
It seems paltry, comical, that this is more of a mandatory lasso, but a person, especially in their disorder, can still be a greater celebration for someone than any tradition. It can be deadly, forbidden, or exemplary, such heterogeneity, it disappoints irregularly or delights! 
You.

I’m not going to hide that I was deeply convinced that Early Access could be released this year.
Only in the summer, a season that was at the same time romantic, a quiet expectation burst and took place. Apart from... Just apart.* 
I usually try to tolerate everything and to not err on at least some of my speculations about this undeciphered burst so I ventured to participate in a jam.
First time in a long while, too. It was then that I realized, after three short months, sometime in October, that in my anxiety and worry I was actually continuing to develop the "main" game.
So now all these fragments are carefully transferred into the events of “the 22nd”.

There was an idea whether to not publish anything on the Steam news section before the release to Early Access, and to mark the outcome with a titular article back in March... 
And there's supposedly an explanation for this delay, but this is not a place for it. 
It is a place for the game that necessarily and hopefully will leave the right message in Self and play up the careless inexorable stress angle. One that shows reflections of needles that have accumulated over the process and which are unlikely to prefer to be mercifully dissolved into a cup of years, I suppose. 
Right now, you can only guess. Love itself became increasingly scarce in the world and that is what ultimately messed up the process quite nicely, but I hope for a continuity where such a thing will remain purely a ghost. 
After all, I dream of cultural meanings that have been settling on the trading shelves of Hearts for years, and said fantasies of mine require even greater sacrifices than the imagined.
This is why there is a coin inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/c317fd43a73927baa24da9999b31273257ae96ae.png[/img]

Places I use for social activity, such as Zolynh, are filled up evenly and I would keep on leaving touches outside the Steam newsfeed canvas, before the real thing, in my own way of thinking, came out. 
But just this week, or to be more specific, in the middle of this week we came across something interesting.
Unfortunately, on the calendar I have, the last Wednesday was the last Wednesday set at the 22nd of the remaining months of this year. Wednesday, Среда, Cрѣда́, Środa, Srzoda, Sredá or Serdà.
But to prevent coming up empty-handed, I’ve built something to show...
Which once again proves how far off course the ship is. 
But essentially, it's just a temporary detour on the way, not a change of direction.
That's why there is still a ship left.

And generally speaking, the world echoes around itself periodically.
An unnatural involvement of the audience or a demand for instantaneous reactions, is once again more often a prerogative of frank pleasure, pernicious but not passionate. The kind of pleasure that destroys the essence with enzymes before it matures. 
And it is hard to change that cycle.
That is why there is a fruit left.

Here and now is simple, but how to preserve the past?

The version protects a stain with stretched image сages, unimpeded cold walls, even the emptiness.  And the rest of the list of accumulated gnats obviously bothers me.

Among other things, I've decided to get the friction up with something a little riskier for the optimization concept. 
Because this game, in a mixture of styles and individual fragments of graphic fundamentals, was originally intended as a "snack" for a wide list of configurations, and the system requirements stem from over-cautiousness.
But the goals have also changed, time has been spent, and at the beginning of this year, I was fearing what if the resources I had were hardly enough for even three months of activity.

[b]• ]Imitating precisely your own impressions[[/b]

It's so delightful to leave short or blank spaces in notes. It's as if there's something you haven’t told.
At least in a world where everything is mixed up and the watchmaker lacks a studio to work in, but the machinist sells formulae of stories, we don't seem obliged to write frankly about the important thing. 
The important thing can already be clothed in the complex, to comfort in the moments of searching those, who become transfixed by despair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39033829/2dfe830e2723a1078af245e8de4bcbd321f06c6e.png[/img]

[b]• ]Through the half-awake weeks[[/b]

... A holiday, on the other hand, pushes to something personal, if not controversial.
I can't stop reflecting on the fact that the date of the New Year is not universal and we can trust the approaching one like a suitcase full of art out of context. 
Clutter outside of tradition and yet here we are, not for the first decade, putting our thoughts on the Internet. 
Years of deepest attachments die along with themed sites, and sometimes the fragments that would be good to erase are densely embedded in the roots. 
No one will dry up the Iron Ship, and the tree in love will no longer cross the desert, but the long-standing set of fervent foolishness still hums on the eaves... It's a shame.
What is this story going to be? 
My wish for You is to get into everything at once and patiently. 
So that any interlocutor You meet, will appear to You, neatly or not, as a Heart with its own dream.

Ё~
A word or two about gaining access to content.
It must be understood that the purpose of the test session is to observe conditions, review, maybe present some feedback and beat a few inconsistencies. 
There are however limits. Such thresholds will be updated before the public marathon, but even during the Early days after release, the “Cosmos” will not be revealed anyway. Conversely, I suspect that not all of the included elements will be solved.
Keys will be attached in leisure messages, so it will take a while.

It is different now, everything has become more… Homologous, perhaps.  
It’s planned to send out a limited version of the game build soon, that would be quite practical. 
Against my own sparse list, Steam Playtest levitates as deliverance.
